title: Things to Do in Boone NC This Weekend | Nov 2026
excerpt: November in the NC High Country is one of the best-kept secrets in the Southeast — the crowds have thinned, the mountains are stunning, and there's more going on than you might expect. Local REALTOR Andrew Plyler breaks down what to do this weekend and why visitors keep turning into buyers.
